```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(psych) #correlation matrix visualization
library(lme4) #mixed regression
library(lmerTest) #p-values for mixed regression
library(Rmisc) #to caluclate within-subj CIs
library(parameters) #standardizes lme parameters
library(corrplot)
library(marginaleffects) #effect sizes
library(effectsize)
library(reshape2)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggpubr) #arrange figures
library(paletteer) #color palettes
```

# Output paths
```{r}
figpath = 'manuscript_figures/'
```

# Input data: EEG
```{r, echo = TRUE}
main_directory <- ""  
fname_enc = paste(main_directory, 'encoding_singletrial_TF.csv', sep="")
fname_sleep = paste(main_directory, 'sleep_singletrial_TF.csv', sep="")

dat_enc_orig <- read.csv(fname_enc)
dat_sleep_orig <- read.csv(fname_sleep)

#Add trial ID to the data
dat_enc_orig$trialID <- 1:dim(dat_enc_orig)[1]
dat_sleep_orig$trialID <- 1:dim(dat_sleep_orig)[1]

#Select baseline method
bl_method = "db" #db, subtr

#Select pipeline
pipeline <- "alltrials" #alltrials, delta_mediansplit

```

# Input data: demogaphics
```{r}
#Participant list (tmr-log)
pathin_tmrlog <- ''
fname_tmrlog <- paste(pathin_tmrlog, 'TMR_log_cleaned_v2.csv', sep="")
data_tmrlog <- read_delim(fname_tmrlog, delim=",")
data_tmrlog <- data_tmrlog %>% filter(tmrlog_visitit=="eeg")

#Calculate age
data_tmrlog$birthdate <- as.Date(data_tmrlog$birthdate)
data_tmrlog$tmrlog_date <- as.Date(data_tmrlog$tmrlog_date)
data_tmrlog$age_in_years = as.numeric(difftime(data_tmrlog$tmrlog_date, data_tmrlog$birthdate, units = "days")) / 365.25 #accounts for leap years

#Join participant list with input data
sublist <- data_tmrlog %>% mutate(subID = paste("sub-", subject_id, sep = "")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(subID, sex, age_in_years)

dat_enc_orig <- left_join(dat_enc_orig, sublist, by="subID")
dat_sleep_orig <- left_join(dat_sleep_orig, sublist, by="subID")
```

# Calculate category-based accuracies
```{r}
#Calculate AFC1-accuracy at the category level
dat_enc_orig <- dat_enc_orig %>% 
  mutate(correct_category_afc1 = ifelse(((afc_correctresp <= 4 & afc1_givenresp <= 4) | 
                                           (afc_correctresp > 4 & afc1_givenresp > 4)),
                                        "correct", "incorrect"
  )
  )
dat_enc_orig$correct_category_afc1 <- as.factor(dat_enc_orig$correct_category_afc1)
levels(dat_enc_orig$correct_category_afc1)
#count(dat_enc_orig$correct_category_afc1)

dat_sleep_orig <- dat_sleep_orig %>% 
  mutate(correct_category_afc1 = ifelse(((afc_correctresp <= 4 & afc1_givenresp <= 4) | 
                                           (afc_correctresp > 4 & afc1_givenresp > 4)),
                                        "correct", "incorrect"
  )
  )
dat_sleep_orig$correct_category_afc1 <- as.factor(dat_sleep_orig$correct_category_afc1)
levels(dat_sleep_orig$correct_category_afc1)
#count(dat_sleep_orig$correct_category_afc1)


#Calculate new variable for AFC1-performance w three levels: category incorrect, cat-correct-item-incorrect, cat-correct-item-correct
dat_enc_orig <- dat_enc_orig %>% 
  mutate(pre_performance = case_when(
    correct_category_afc1 == "incorrect" ~ "cat_incorrect",
    correct_category_afc1 == "correct" & afc1_accuracy == 0 ~ "cat_correct_item_incorrect",
    correct_category_afc1 == "correct" & afc1_accuracy == 1 ~ "cat_correct_item_correct"
  )) 
dat_enc_orig$pre_performance <- as.factor(dat_enc_orig$pre_performance)
levels(dat_enc_orig$pre_performance)
#count(dat_enc_orig$pre_performance)

dat_sleep_orig <- dat_sleep_orig %>% 
  mutate(pre_performance = case_when(
    correct_category_afc1 == "incorrect" ~ "cat_incorrect",
    correct_category_afc1 == "correct" & afc1_accuracy == 0 ~ "cat_correct_item_incorrect",
    correct_category_afc1 == "correct" & afc1_accuracy == 1 ~ "cat_correct_item_correct"
  )) 
dat_sleep_orig$pre_performance <- as.factor(dat_sleep_orig$pre_performance)
levels(dat_sleep_orig$pre_performance)
#count(dat_sleep_orig$pre_performance)
```

# Outliers (participant specific)
```{r}
#Select data
dat_enc_flagged <- dat_enc_orig %>% dplyr::select(subID, itemID, trialID, tmr_cued, tmr_repetitions, condition, vividness,
                                           age_in_years, sex, 
                                           afc1_accuracy, afc2_accuracy, afc5_accuracy, retrieval_accuracy,
                                           pre_performance,
                                           delta_db, theta_db,
                                           delta_subtr, theta_subtr,
                                           delta_plow, theta_plow) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(starts_with("delta") | starts_with("theta")),
               values_to = "power",
               names_to = c("frequency", "baseline"),
               names_sep = "_")

dat_sleep_flagged <- dat_sleep_orig %>% dplyr::select(subID, itemID, trialID, learned, repetition, condition, vividness,  
                                               age_in_years, sex, 
                                               afc1_accuracy, afc2_accuracy, afc5_accuracy, retrieval_accuracy,
                                               pre_performance,
                                               enc_delta_db, enc_theta_db,
                                               enc_delta_subtr, enc_theta_subtr,
                                               delta_db, theta_db, lowsigma_db, highsigma_db,
                                               delta_subtr, theta_subtr, lowsigma_subtr, highsigma_subtr,
                                               delta_plow, theta_plow, lowsigma_plow, highsigma_plow) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(starts_with("delta") | starts_with("theta") | starts_with("lowsigma") | starts_with("highsigma")),
               values_to = "power",
               names_to = c("frequency", "baseline"),
               names_sep = "_")


#Log transform baseline power and divisive baseline power to remove "positivity bias"
dat_enc_flagged$power_tf <- 10*(log10(dat_enc_flagged$power))
dat_enc_flagged$power_tf[dat_enc_flagged$baseline == "subtr"] <-dat_enc_flagged$power[dat_enc_flagged$baseline == "subtr"] #replace subtractive bl values with the original values (no log-transform)

dat_sleep_flagged$power_tf <- 10*(log10(dat_sleep_flagged$power))
dat_sleep_flagged$power_tf[dat_sleep_flagged$baseline == "subtr"] <-dat_sleep_flagged$power[dat_sleep_flagged$baseline == "subtr"] #replace subtractive bl values with the original values (no log-transform)


#Mark trials based on SD threshold
sd_thresh = 5

dat_enc_flagged <- dat_enc_flagged %>%
  group_by(subID, frequency, baseline) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_p = mean(power_tf, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_p   = sd(power_tf, na.rm = TRUE),
    z_p    = (power_tf - mean_p) / sd_p,
    is_outlier = abs(z_p) >= sd_thresh
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

dat_sleep_flagged <- dat_sleep_flagged %>%
  group_by(subID, frequency, baseline) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_p = mean(power_tf, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_p   = sd(power_tf, na.rm = TRUE),
    z_p    = (power_tf - mean_p) / sd_p,
    is_outlier = abs(z_p) >= sd_thresh
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

#How many trials removed (in total and by participant
dat_enc_flagged %>%
  group_by(frequency, baseline) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_trials = n(),
    outliers = sum(is_outlier, na.rm = TRUE),
    percent_removed = 100 * outliers / total_trials
  )

dat_enc_flagged %>%
  group_by(subID, frequency, baseline) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_trials = n(),
    n_outliers = sum(is_outlier),
    pct_outliers = 100 * n_outliers / n_trials
  )

dat_sleep_flagged %>%
  group_by(frequency, baseline) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_trials = n(),
    outliers = sum(is_outlier, na.rm = TRUE),
    percent_removed = 100 * outliers / total_trials
  )

dat_sleep_flagged %>%
  group_by(subID, frequency, baseline) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_trials = n(),
    n_outliers = sum(is_outlier),
    pct_outliers = 100 * n_outliers / n_trials
  )


#Revome outliers
dat_enc_clean <- dat_enc_flagged %>%
  filter(!is_outlier) %>% 
  ungroup()

dat_sleep_clean <- dat_sleep_flagged %>%
  filter(!is_outlier) %>% 
  ungroup

#Visualization
dat_enc_flagged %>% ggplot(aes(x=subID, y=z_p, color=is_outlier)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_grid(baseline ~ frequency) +
  ggtitle("encoding") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = sd_thresh, 
             linetype = "dashed", 
             color = "black") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -sd_thresh, 
             linetype = "dashed", 
             color = "black") +
  theme_bw()


dat_sleep_flagged %>% ggplot(aes(x=subID, y=z_p, color=is_outlier)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_grid(baseline ~ frequency) +
  ggtitle("sleep") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = sd_thresh, 
             linetype = "dashed", 
             color = "black") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -sd_thresh, 
             linetype = "dashed", 
             color = "black") +
  theme_bw()


```

# Aggregate sleep data over TMR repetitions
```{r}
#aggregate by averaing over linear (raw) power values
dat_sleep_items_clean <- dat_sleep_clean %>% 
  group_by(subID, itemID, frequency, baseline) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    power = mean(power, na.rm = TRUE),
    across(
      .cols = -c(power, repetition),
      .fns  = first
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

#10*log10 over values (db only)
dat_sleep_items_clean$power_tf <- 10*log10(dat_sleep_items_clean$power)
dat_sleep_items_clean$power_tf[dat_sleep_items_clean$baseline == "subtr"] <-dat_sleep_items_clean$power[dat_sleep_items_clean$baseline == "subtr"] 
```

# Scale/log10 encoding values in sleep data
```{r}

if (bl_method == "db") { 
  dat_sleep <- dat_sleep %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    mutate(enc_theta = 10*log10(enc_theta_db),
           enc_delta = 10*log10(enc_delta_db)
           ) 
  
  dat_sleep_items <- dat_sleep_items %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    mutate(enc_theta = 10*log10(enc_theta_db),
           enc_delta = 10*log10(enc_delta_db)
           )
} else {
  dat_sleep <- dat_sleep %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    mutate(enc_theta = scale(enc_theta_subtr),
           enc_delta = scale(enc_delta_subtr)) 
  
  dat_sleep_items <- dat_sleep_items %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    mutate(enc_theta = scale(enc_theta_subtr),
           enc_delta = scale(enc_delta_subtr)) 
}
  
```

# Median split based on delta response (control analysis)
```{r}
if (pipeline == "delta_mediansplit") {
  dat_sleep <- dat_sleep %>% group_by(subID) %>% 
    filter(learned == 1) %>% 
    dplyr:: mutate(median_delta = median(delta)) %>% 
    filter(delta >= median_delta) %>% 
    ungroup()
  
  dat_sleep_items <- dat_sleep_items %>% group_by(subID) %>% 
    filter(learned == 1) %>% 
    dplyr:: mutate(median_delta = median(delta)) %>% 
    filter(delta >= median_delta) %>% 
    ungroup()
  
  #Save data for control-behavioral analysis
  fname = paste(main_directory, 'sleepitems_TF_highdelta.rds', sep="")
  save("dat_sleep_items", file=fname)
}
```

# Correlations per participant (implemented by Claude, so double-check if deciding to publish)
```{r}
res <- dat_sleep_items %>%
  pivot_longer(c(enc_delta, enc_theta), names_to = "x_var", values_to = "x") %>%
  pivot_longer(c(delta, theta, lowsigma, highsigma), names_to = "y_var", values_to = "y") %>%
  group_by(subID, x_var, y_var) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    r  = cor.test(x, y)$estimate,
    lo = cor.test(x, y)$conf.int[1],
    hi = cor.test(x, y)$conf.int[2],
    p  = cor.test(x, y)$p.value,
    n  = sum(!is.na(x) & !is.na(y)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
 
p_indcorrs <- res %>%
  mutate(sig = case_when(lo > 0 ~ "positive",
                         hi < 0 ~ "negative",
                         TRUE   ~ "n.s."),
         sig = factor(sig, levels = c("positive", "n.s.", "negative"))) %>%
  group_by(x_var, y_var) %>%
  mutate(pair = paste0(x_var, " vs. ", y_var, "\n",
                       "pos: ",  round(100 * mean(sig == "positive")), "%   ",
                       "n.s.: ", round(100 * mean(sig == "n.s.")),     "%   ",
                       "neg: ",  round(100 * mean(sig == "negative")), "%")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(sub_pair = reorder(paste(pair, subID, sep = "__"), -r)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sub_pair, y = r, fill = sig)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), width = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  facet_wrap(~ pair, nrow = 2, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("positive" = "firebrick",
                               "n.s."     = "grey75",
                               "negative" = "steelblue")) +
  labs(x = "Participant", y = "r", fill = NULL) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
p_indcorrs

#That's a heterogeneity test, as in meta-analysis (Cochran's Q). Each participant's r is Fisher-z #transformed and weighted by n − 3. Q measures how much the z values spread around the weighted mean, and #without true differences it follows a χ² distribution with k − 1 degrees of freedom.
res %>%
  group_by(x_var, y_var) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Q  = sum((n - 3) * (atanh(r) - weighted.mean(atanh(r), n - 3))^2),
            df = n() - 1,
            p  = pchisq(Q, df, lower.tail = FALSE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(p_holm = p.adjust(p, method = "holm"))
```

# Factorize variables and set contrasts
```{r}
#Factorizing: encoding
dat_enc$subID <- as.factor(dat_enc$subID)
dat_enc$trialID <- as.factor(dat_enc$trialID)
dat_enc$itemID <- as.factor(dat_enc$itemID)
dat_enc$sex <- as.factor(dat_enc$sex)
dat_enc$tmr_cued <- as.factor(dat_enc$tmr_cued)
dat_enc$condition <- as.factor(dat_enc$condition)
dat_enc$pre_performance <- as.factor(dat_enc$pre_performance)

contrasts(dat_enc$sex) <- c(-0.5, 0.5)
contrasts(dat_enc$tmr_cued) <- c(-0.5, 0.5)
contrasts(dat_enc$condition) <- c(-0.5, 0.5)
contrasts(dat_enc$pre_performance) <- t(rbind(c(c(1/3, 1/3, -2/3)), #category correct vs incorrect 
                                            c(0.5, -0.5, 0))) #item correct vs incorrect, 

#Factorizing: sleep
dat_sleep$subID <- as.factor(dat_sleep$subID)
dat_sleep$trialID <- as.factor(dat_sleep$trialID)
dat_sleep$itemID <- as.factor(dat_sleep$itemID)
dat_sleep$sex <- as.factor(dat_sleep$sex)
dat_sleep$condition <- as.factor(dat_sleep$condition)

contrasts(dat_sleep$sex) <- c(-0.5, 0.5)
contrasts(dat_sleep$pre_performance) <- c(-0.5, 0.5)
```

# Encoding : learned vs forgotten
```{r}
#Long format to include memory testing timepoints
dat_enc_long <- dat_enc %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(afc1_accuracy, afc2_accuracy, afc5_accuracy),
               names_to = c("timepoint", "afc"),
               names_sep = "_",
               values_to = "accuracy")


# Factorizing and contrasts
dat_enc_long$timepoint <- as.factor(dat_enc_long$timepoint)
contrasts(dat_enc_long$timepoint) <- matrix(
  c(
     0.5, -0.5,  0,   # T1 vs T2
     0,  0.5, -0.5    # T2 vs T3
  ),
  ncol = 2
)
colnames(contrasts(dat_enc_long$timepoint)) <- c("AFC1_vs_AFC2", "AFC2_vs_AFC5")

# Fit model: no interactions
mod_enc_orig <- glmer(accuracy ~ delta + theta + 
                        timepoint + 
                        vividness + 
                        condition +
                        age_in_years + sex +
                        (1 | subID/itemID), 
                      data = dat_enc_long, 
                      family = binomial, nAGQ = 0L)
summary(mod_enc_orig)


#Fit model: vividness interactions
mod_enc_vivint <- glmer(accuracy ~ delta + theta + 
                          timepoint + vividness + 
                          condition +
                   delta*vividness + theta*vividness +
                   age_in_years + sex +
                   (1 | subID/itemID), 
               data = dat_enc_long, 
              family = binomial, nAGQ = 0L)
summary(mod_enc_vivint)

#Fit model: timepoint interactions
mod_enc_timeint <- glmer(accuracy ~ delta + theta + 
                           timepoint + vividness + 
                           condition +
                   delta*timepoint + theta*timepoint +
                   age_in_years + sex +
                   (1 | subID/itemID), 
               data = dat_enc_long, 
              family = binomial, nAGQ = 0L)
summary(mod_enc_timeint)




cbind(
  AIC(mod_enc_orig, mod_enc_vivint, mod_enc_timeint),
  BIC(mod_enc_orig, mod_enc_vivint, mod_enc_timeint))[, c(1, 2, 4)] %>% 
  mutate(
    model = rownames(.)
  )

anova(mod_enc_orig, mod_enc_vivint)
anova(mod_enc_orig, mod_enc_timeint)
```

# Effects of the selected model
```{r}
mod_select <- mod_enc_vivint
summary(mod_select)

#Odd's ratios
ors <- exp(cbind(OR = fixef(mod_select), confint(mod_select, parm = "beta_", method = "Wald")))

#AMEs for continous variables
ame_cont <- avg_slopes(mod_select, 
                       variables = c("delta", "theta", "vividness", "age_in_years"),
           type = "response", re.form = NA)

#AMEs for categorical variables
ame_cat <- avg_comparisons(mod_select, 
                           variables = c("condition", "sex"),
                           type = "response", re.form = NA)

ame_cat_time1  <- avg_predictions(mod_select, 
                                  variables = "timepoint", 
                                  type = "response",
                                  re.form = NA, hypothesis = "b1 - b2 = 0")

ame_cat_time2 <- avg_predictions(mod_select, 
                                 variables = "timepoint", 
                                 type = "response",
                                re.form = NA, hypothesis = "b2-b3 = 0")

#Interaction (theta + vividness)
# AME of theta at each level of vividness (interaction effect)
ame_int_thetaviv <- avg_slopes(
  mod_select,
  variables  = "theta",
  type       = "response",
  newdata    = datagrid(vividness = 1:4),
  by        = "vividness"
)

#Scale theta and theta*interactions with SD for better interpretation
theta_sd <- sd(dat_enc_long$theta, na.rm = TRUE)
100 * theta_sd * unlist(ame_cont[ame_cont$term == "theta", c("estimate", "conf.low", "conf.high")])  # AME per SD (pp)

ame_int_thetaviv$estimate_sd <- ame_int_thetaviv$estimate * theta_sd*100
ame_int_thetaviv$ci_low_sd   <- ame_int_thetaviv$conf.low * theta_sd*100
ame_int_thetaviv$ci_high_sd  <- ame_int_thetaviv$conf.high * theta_sd*100

print(ame_int_thetaviv)



#Random effects
re <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(mod_select))
re

ngrps(mod_select)
nobs(mod_select)
```

# Selected model into table
```{r}
## ---- 1. Edit these three blocks to match your model ------------------

# Coefficient name (as in summary) -> label in the table
labels <- c(
  "(Intercept)"    = "Intercept",
  "delta" = "delta",
  "theta" = "theta",
  "vividness"          = "vividness",
  "timepointAFC1_vs_AFC2" = "test time (pre-sleep - 12h)",
  "timepointAFC2_vs_AFC5" = "test time (12h - 5d)",
  "condition1" = "category",
  "age_in_years" = "age (years)",
  "sex1" = "sex",
  "delta:vividness"  = "delta \u00d7 vividness",
  "theta:vividness" = "theta \u00d7 vividness"
)

# Coefficient name -> term name in ame_cont / ame_cat (main effects only)
ame_map <- c(
  "delta" = "delta",
  "theta" = "theta",
  "vividness"          = "vividness",
  "age_in_years"    = "age_in_years",
  "condition1" = "condition",
  "sex1" = "sex",
  "timepointAFC1_vs_AFC2" = "test time (pre-sleep - 12h)",
  "timepointAFC2_vs_AFC5" = "test time (12h - 5h)") 



# Significant interactions: coefficient name -> simple-effect AMEs and the
# 'by' variable used to compute them
int_map <- list(
  "theta:vividness"  = list(ame = ame_int_thetaviv,  by = "vividness")
  )

out_file <- "table_mod_eeg_encoding.txt"

## ---- 2. Helpers -----------------------------------------------------
fmt    <- function(x, d = 2) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d)
fmt_ci <- function(lo, hi, d = 2) paste0("[", fmt(lo, d), ", ", fmt(hi, d), "]")
fmt_p  <- function(p) ifelse(p < .001, "< .001",
                             sub("^0", "", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)))
lab    <- function(nm) if (nm %in% names(labels)) labels[[nm]] else nm

## ---- 3. Build the table ---------------------------------------------
cf <- summary(mod_select)$coefficients

cols <- c("term", "estimate", "conf.low", "conf.high")
ame_main <- rbind(as.data.frame(ame_cont)[, cols],
                  as.data.frame(ame_cat)[, cols])

cols <- c("estimate", "conf.low", "conf.high")
ame_main <- rbind(ame_main,
  data.frame(term = "test time (pre-sleep - 12h)", as.data.frame(ame_cat_time1)[, cols]),
  data.frame(term = "test time (12h - 5h)", as.data.frame(ame_cat_time2)[, cols]))


out <- paste("Predictor", "OR", "95% CI", "p", "AME (pp)", "95% CI", sep = "\t")

for (nm in rownames(cf)) {
  # main-effect AME, if this coefficient has one
  a <- ame_main[ame_main$term %in% ame_map[nm], ]
  ame_txt <- if (nrow(a) == 1) {
    c(fmt(100 * a$estimate), fmt_ci(100 * a$conf.low, 100 * a$conf.high))
  } else c("", "")

  out <- c(out, paste(lab(nm),
                      fmt(ors[nm, 1]), fmt_ci(ors[nm, 2], ors[nm, 3]),
                      fmt_p(cf[nm, 4]),
                      ame_txt[1], ame_txt[2], sep = "\t"))

  # simple-effect AMEs under significant interactions
  if (nm %in% names(int_map)) {
    x   <- as.data.frame(int_map[[nm]]$ame)
    byv <- int_map[[nm]]$by
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(x))) {
      out <- c(out, paste(
        paste0("    ", x$term[i], " at ", byv, " = ", x[[byv]][i]),
        "", "", "",
        fmt(100 * x$estimate[i]),
        fmt_ci(100 * x$conf.low[i], 100 * x$conf.high[i]), sep = "\t"))
    }
  }
}

## ---- 3b. Random effects ----------------------------------------------
re_labels <- c("itemID:subID" = "Item within participant (intercept)",
               "subID"        = "Participant (intercept)")

re <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(mod_select))
ng <- ngrps(mod_select)

out <- c(out, "", "Random effects",
         paste("Grouping factor", "Variance", "SD", "N groups", sep = "\t"))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(re))) {
  g <- re$grp[i]
  out <- c(out, paste(if (g %in% names(re_labels)) re_labels[[g]] else g,
                      fmt(re$vcov[i], 3), fmt(re$sdcor[i], 3),
                      format(ng[[g]], big.mark = ","), sep = "\t"))
}

out <- c(out, paste("N observations",
                    format(nobs(mod_select), big.mark = ","), sep = "\t"))

## ---- 3c. Model fit ---------------------------------------------------
var_fix  <- var(as.vector(getME(mod_select, "X") %*% fixef(mod_select)))
var_rand <- sum(re$vcov)      # random-intercept variances from 3b
var_res  <- pi^2 / 3          # residual variance, logit link
tot      <- var_fix + var_rand + var_res

out <- c(out, "", "Model fit",
         paste("Marginal R\u00b2",    fmt(var_fix / tot, 3), sep = "\t"),
         paste("Conditional R\u00b2", fmt((var_fix + var_rand) / tot, 3), sep = "\t"))



## ---- 4. Write -------------------------------------------------------
con <- file(out_file, open = "w", encoding = "UTF-8")
writeLines(out, con)
close(con)
cat(out, sep = "\n")
```

### Write into a table
```{r}
if (pipeline == "alltrials") {
## ---- 1. Settings (edit these) ---------------------------------------
# One row per model; names become the "Outcome" column
models <- list(
  "Delta"      = mod_delta,
  "Theta"      = mod_theta,
  "Low sigma"  = mod_lowsigma,
  "High sigma" = mod_highsigma
)

term     <- "learned"   # coefficient name of learned vs. new (see summary())
grp      <- "subID"      # grouping factor of the random intercept
out_file <- "table_eeg_sleep_learned.txt"

## ---- 2. Helpers -----------------------------------------------------
fmt    <- function(x, d = 2) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d)
fmt_ci <- function(lo, hi, d = 2) paste0("[", fmt(lo, d), ", ", fmt(hi, d), "]")
fmt_p  <- function(p) ifelse(p < .001, "< .001",
                             sub("^0", "", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)))

## ---- 3. Extract everything per model --------------------------------
res <- lapply(models, function(m) {
  y_sd <- sd(getME(m, "y"))                       # SD of the outcome

  # Satterthwaite df and p-values if lmerTest is installed, else normal approx.
  cf <- tryCatch(coef(summary(lmerTest::as_lmerModLmerTest(m))),
                 error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(cf)) {
    df <- cf[term, "df"]
    p  <- cf[term, "Pr(>|t|)"]
  } else {
    cf <- coef(summary(m))
    df <- Inf
    p  <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(cf[term, "t value"]))
  }
  b    <- cf[term, "Estimate"]
  se   <- cf[term, "Std. Error"]
  crit <- qt(.975, df)

  vc    <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(m))
  v_sub <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == grp]
  v_res <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "Residual"]
  v_fix <- var(as.vector(getME(m, "X") %*% fixef(m)))
  tot   <- v_fix + v_sub + v_res

  data.frame(
    beta   = b / y_sd,                            # standardized difference
    lo     = (b - crit * se) / y_sd,
    hi     = (b + crit * se) / y_sd,
    p      = p,
    sd_sub = sqrt(v_sub) / y_sd,                  # in outcome-SD units
    sd_res = sqrt(v_res) / y_sd,
    icc    = v_sub / (v_sub + v_res),
    r2m    = v_fix / tot,
    r2c    = (v_fix + v_sub) / tot,
    n_obs  = nobs(m),
    n_grp  = ngrps(m)[[grp]],
    satt   = is.finite(df)
  )
})
res <- do.call(rbind, res)
res$p_holm <- p.adjust(res$p, method = "holm")    # correction across the models

## ---- 4. Build the table ---------------------------------------------
out <- paste("Outcome", "\u03b2", "95% CI", "p", "p (Holm)",
             "SD (participant)", "SD (residual)", "Conditional R\u00b2", sep = "\t")

for (i in seq_len(nrow(res))) {
  r <- res[i, ]
  out <- c(out, paste(rownames(res)[i],
                      fmt(r$beta), fmt_ci(r$lo, r$hi),
                      fmt_p(r$p), fmt_p(r$p_holm),
                      fmt(r$sd_sub), fmt(r$sd_res), 
                      fmt(r$r2c, 3), sep = "\t"))
}

## ---- 5. Note --------------------------------------------------------
n_txt <- function(x) if (length(unique(x)) == 1) format(x[1], big.mark = ",") else
  paste0(format(min(x), big.mark = ","), "\u2013", format(max(x), big.mark = ","))

note <- paste0(
  "Note. Separate linear mixed models were fitted for each EEG feature ",
  "(feature ~ learned + (1 | ", grp, ")) with lme4. Learned vs. new items were ",
  "contrast-coded (\u22120.5, 0.5). \u03b2 = difference between learned and new items ",
  "in standard deviations of the respective EEG feature, with 95% confidence interval",
  if (all(res$satt)) " and p-values based on Satterthwaite degrees of freedom (lmerTest). "
  else " and p-values based on the normal approximation. ",
  "p (Holm) = p-values corrected for multiple comparisons across the ", nrow(res),
  " models (Holm, 1979). Random-effect SDs are expressed in standard deviations of ",
  "the respective feature. ICC = proportion of the residual variance (not explained ",
  "by the fixed effect) attributable to participants. Marginal and conditional R\u00b2 ",
  "after Nakagawa & Schielzeth (2013). N = ", n_txt(res$n_obs), " observations from ",
  n_txt(res$n_grp), " participants per model."
)
out <- c(out, "", note)

## ---- 6. Write -------------------------------------------------------
con <- file(out_file, open = "w", encoding = "UTF-8")
writeLines(out, con)
close(con)
cat(out, sep = "\n")
}
```

```{r}
p_sub <- tapply(dat_sleep_items$learned, dat_sleep_items$subID, mean)
sd(p_sub)                                    # observed spread between participants
p <- mean(dat_sleep_items$learned)
sqrt(p * (1 - p) / 96)                       # spread expected from binomial noise alone


ngrps(mod_select)
nobs(mod_select)
}
```

# Visualization
```{r}
if (pipeline == "alltrials") {


#Visualization
pal <- paletteer_d("lisa::PabloPicasso_1")

dat_sleep_items_long_tmp <- dat_sleep_items %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(delta, theta, lowsigma, highsigma),
               values_to = "power",
               names_to = "frequency")

learned_new_means <- summarySEwithin(
  data = dat_sleep_items_long_tmp,
  measurevar = "power",
  withinvars = c("learned", "frequency"),
  idvar = "subID",
  na.rm = TRUE)

learned_new_means$learned <- factor(learned_new_means$learned,
                           levels = 0:1,
                           labels = c("new", "learned"))

fig_delta <- learned_new_means %>% ggplot(aes(x=learned, y = power, group = frequency, color = frequency)) +
  geom_line(size = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +

  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = power - se,
        ymax = power + se),
    width = 0.1,
    size = 0.6) +
  labs(
    y = "Power (db)"
  ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = pal[1:4]) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 8) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        axis.title.x = element_blank())
fig_delta
}
```

# EEG-vividness associations

```{r}
if (pipeline == "alltrials") {

mod_viv <- lmer(vividness ~ delta+theta +
                  age_in_years + sex +
                  (1 | subID),
                data = dat_enc)
summary(mod_viv)
eta_squared(mod_viv, partial=TRUE)


#Visualization
dat_enc_long_tmp <- dat_enc %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(delta, theta),
               values_to = "power",
               names_to = "frequency")

viv_means <- dat_enc_long_tmp %>% 
  group_by(subID, vividness, frequency) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(m_power = mean(power)) %>% 
  ungroup()
 
viv_means <- summarySEwithin(
  data = viv_means,
  measurevar = "m_power",
  withinvars = c("vividness", "frequency"),
  idvar = "subID",
  na.rm = TRUE
) %>%  filter(vividness != "NaN")


fig_viv_encoding <- viv_means %>% ggplot(aes(x=vividness, y = m_power, group = frequency, color = frequency)) +
  geom_line(size = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +

  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = m_power - se,
        ymax = m_power + se),
    width = 0.1,
    size = 0.6) +
  labs(
    x = "Vividness",
    y = "Power (db)",
    title = "Encoding"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal[1:2]) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 8) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
fig_viv_encoding  

#Sleep
mod_viv_sleep <- lmer(power ~ vividness * frequency + age_in_years + sex + (1 | subID/itemID),
                 data = dat_sleep_items_long_tmp)
summary(mod_viv_sleep)

  withinvars = c("vividness", "frequency"),
  idvar = "subID",
  na.rm = TRUE
) %>%  filter(vividness != "NaN")


fig_viv_sleep <- viv_means_sleep %>% ggplot(aes(x=vividness, y = m_power, group = frequency, color = frequency)) +
  geom_line(size = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +

  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = m_power - se,
        ymax = m_power + se),
    width = 0.1,

  labs(

    y = "Power (db)",
    title = "Sleep"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal[1:4]) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 8) +

fig_viv_sleep

}
```
